name: Impossible Travel / Geo Anomaly Detection
description: Detects authentication from two geographically distant locations within an impossible travel timeframe.
query: SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) | where ResultType == 0 | extend GeoInfo = parse_json(LocationDetails) | summarize Locations = make_set(tostring(GeoInfo.countryOrRegion)), IPList = make_set(IPAddress) by UserPrincipalName | where array_length(Locations) > 1
